y-m-07-06.title: Amakhadi ezinombolo angu-3: isiphumo siba sikhulu kuphi?
y-m-07-06.topic: Ukuthola amacala anesiphumo esikhulu uma wenza izibalo ze-(inombolo enezinombolo ezimbili)×(inombolo eyodwa) ngamakhadi ezinombolo
y-m-07-06.goal: Hlola umbono othi "uma wenza inombolo enezinombolo ezimbili enkulu kakhulu, isiphumo naso sikhulu kakhulu" ngokwenza izibalo wena, thola izibalo eziningana ezinesiphumo esikhulu, bese ubhala ukuthi kungani.
y-m-07-06.material: Kukhona ikhadi elilodwa ngalinye lamakhadi ezinombolo 3, 5, no-7. Sebenzisa ikhadi ngalinye kanye ngqo ukwenza isibalo se-(inombolo enezinombolo ezimbili)×(inombolo eyodwa). Isibonelo, beka u-3 no-5 eceleni komunye nomunye ukwenza u-35 bese uphindaphinda ngo-7, kunika u-35×7 (amashumi amathathu nanhlanu izikhathi eziyisikhombisa). Ungaphenduli amakhadi. UHarin wathi, "Uma ngenza inombolo enezinombolo ezimbili enkulu kakhulu, u-75, ngiphindaphinda ngo-3, isiphumo sizoba sikhulu kakhulu!"
y-m-07-06.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi kungani isiphumo siba sikhulu
y-m-07-06.prereq.1: Indlela yokwenza inombolo enezinombolo ezimbili ngamakhadi ezinombolo (indawo yamashumi, indawo yamayunithi)
y-m-07-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isinqumo ongasenza manje mayelana nalokho okushiwo uHarin.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.0: Yenza esinye isibalo ngaphandle kuka-75×3, sibale wena, bese uqhathanisa iziphumo.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ubale ukuthi zingaki izibalo ezingenziwa sekuyonke ngamakhadi ama-3.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile. Uma inombolo enezinombolo ezimbili inkulu kakhulu, isiphumo nasso sikhulu kakhulu.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.a: Inombolo eyodwa oyiphindaphinda ngayo nayo iyashintsha kuye ngamakhadi. Akufanele ubheke inombolo enezinombolo ezimbili kuphela.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.b: Asazi okwamanje. Sidinga ukuliqhathanisa neziphumo zokunye ukuhlelwa kwamakhadi.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kubone ukuthi kufanele uhlole ukuthi isitatimende silungile yini ngokuqhathanisa nezinye izibalo. Isinqumo esihle sokuzama ukuqoqa ubufakazi.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.c: Akubonakali kulungile. Isiphindaphindi 3 sincane, ngakho kungaba ukulahlekelwa.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kukhombisile ukuthi isiphindaphindi siba sincane. Kodwa njengoba kuyisiqagelo, udinga ukuhlola ngokuqhathanisa nezinye izibalo.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.d: Isiphumo sifana noma ubabeka kanjani, ngakho akudingeki ukuqhathanisa.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.d: Ngaphambi kokunquma ukuthi iziphumo ziyafana, bala izibalo ezimbalwa wena. Zingahluka kakhulu.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.explain: 75×3=225. Uma ubala ezinye izibalo, kunamasiphumo amakhulu, njenge-35×7=245. Isitatimende sikaHarin asilungile, kodwa ukuzama izibalo ezimbalwa kuqala yindlela enhle yokuhlola.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.acc.0: Lesi yisiqagelo esinengqondo. Kodwa njengoba kuyisiqagelo, kufanele uthole iziphumo wena ukuze uhlole.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibalo ezi-2 ezihlukile ezinesiphumo esikhulu kuno-240. Ikhadi lamashumi ngu-t, ikhadi lamayunithi ngu-u, futhi ikhadi eliphindaphindayo ngu-m. Kufanele usebenzise amakhadi 3, 5, no-7 kanye ngalinye.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.0: Beka ikhadi elilodwa ngalinye endaweni yamashumi, endaweni yamayunithi, nasendaweni yesiphindaphindi bese ubala isiphumo.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.1: Uthatha isiphumo sika-75×3 njengesilinganiso, qhathanisa ukuthi isiphumo sishintsha kanjani uma ushintsha indawo lapho ubeka khona u-7.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Zonke izindawo ezintathu ziyinye ka-3, 5, noma 7.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Akufanele usebenzise ikhadi elifanayo kabili. Kufanele usebenzise u-3, 5, no-7 kanye ngalinye.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Isiphumo asikhulu kuno-240. Zama ukushintsha izindawo zamakhadi.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.explain: Kunezibalo ezi-6 sekuyonke ezingenziwa ngamakhadi ama-3. Kuzo, izibalo ezi-3 zinkulu kuno-240, futhi 35×7=245 siyisibonelo esisodwa. U-75×3 kaHarin ungu-225, ngakho awufinyeleli ku-240.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.prompt: Kuzibalo ezi-6 ezingenziwa ngamakhadi 3, 5, no-7, yisiphi isibalo esinesiphumo esikhulu kakhulu? Futhi bhala ukuthi kungani indlela kaHarin (75×3) ingazange inike isiphumo esikhulu kakhulu.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bala iziphumo zazo zonke izibalo ezi-6, uzibhale ethebuleni, bese uzungeza esikhulu kakhulu.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi liyiphi ikhadi eliyisiphindaphindi esibalweni esinesiphumo esikhulu kakhulu nasesibalweni sikaHarin.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Isibalo esinesiphumo esikhulu kakhulu ngu-... Indlela kaHarin ... ngoba ...
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unqume isiphumo esikhulu kakhulu ngemva kokubala zonke ezi-6?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqhathanise lapho u-7 ubekwe khona esibalweni sikaHarin nasesibalweni esinesiphumo esikhulu kakhulu?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubhale ngamazwi akho ukuthi kungani indlela ethi "yenza inombolo enezinombolo ezimbili kuphela ibe nkulu" ingeyanele?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.model.0: Isiphumo esikhulu kakhulu ngu-53×7=371. Uma wenza u-75 njengoHarin, isiphindaphindi singu-3, ngakho 75×3=225 incane. Ukusebenzisa inombolo enkulu 7 njengesiphindaphindi kwakukukhulu.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.model.1: Ukusebenzisa u-7 njengesiphindaphindi nokwenza u-53 ngokusele, 53×7=371, kukhulu kakhulu. 75×3=225, ngakho indlela kaHarin yayingalungile.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.model.2: Isibalo esinesiphumo esikhulu kakhulu ngu-53×7. Ku-75×3, isiphindaphindi singu-3 omncane, ngakho besingeyona esikhulu kakhulu.

y-m-07-05.title: 1/2 no-1/4 webhande: ubani osebenzise okuningi?
y-m-07-05.topic: Izingxenyana zingaqhathaniswa ngosayizi kuphela uma okuphelele kufana (izingxenyana zeziphelele ezihlukile)
y-m-07-05.goal: Qaphela ukuthi izingxenyana zeziphelele ezihlukile azikwazi ukuqhathaniswa ngosayizi bezingxenyana kuphela, hlunga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olenza ukuqhathanisa kwenzeke, bese uthola ngezinombolo amacala lapho ubude abantu ababili abasebenzise bufana.
y-m-07-05.material: UJian usebenzise u-1/2 webhande elibomvu, no-Doyun usebenzise u-1/4 webhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Asazi ukuthi amabhande amabili ayenobude obufanayo ekuqaleni. Ibhande ngalinye lalingucezu olulodwa olungakasikwa, futhi 1/2 no-1/4 kusho okuphelele kwebhande lomuntu ngamunye kuhlukaniswe kwaba izingxenye ezilinganayo. 1/2 ifundwa "ingxenye eyodwa kwezimbili" futhi 1/4 ifundwa "ingxenye eyodwa kwezine."
y-m-07-05.prereq.0: Ukuthi ingxenyana ikhombisa ukuthi zingaki izingxenye ezilinganayo zokuphelele
y-m-07-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha lokho ongakusho mayelana nokuthi ngubani osebenzise ibhande elide, usebenzisa kuphela lokho okwaziwayo manje.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nquma ubude bebhande elibomvu nebhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka noma ngayiphi indlela (isibonelo: 20cm, 40cm) bese ubhala ubude abantu ababili abasebenzise ngabo nge-cm.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.hint.1: Shintsha ubude bamabhande bese uhlola ukuthi ukuthi ngubani osebenzisa okuningi kuyashintsha yini.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.o.a: Asazi ubude bokuqala bamabhande amabili, ngakho asikwazi ukunquma.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kukhombise ukuthi ingxenyana imayelana no-"okuphelele kwayo." Cabanga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe olungakuvumela ukuthi unqume.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.b: 1/2 inkulu kuno-1/4 kuphela uma iqhathaniswa kokuphelele okufanayo. Qala ubheke ukuthi okuphelele kwamabhande amabili kufana yini.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.c: Isihlukanisi esikhulu akwenzi ubude obusetshenzisiwe bube bude. Uma okuphelele kuhlukile, ukuthi ingakanani nge-cm kuyashintsha.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.o.d: Mhlawumbe nguJian. Akuvamile ukuthi okuphelele kuhluke.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.d: Akukho sisekelo sokusho ukuthi "akuvamile." Hlola ngezinombolo ukuthi kwenzekani uma amabhande enezigaba ezihlukile.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.explain: 1/2 inkulu kuno-1/4 uma iqhathaniswa kokuphelele okufanayo (amabhande obude obufanayo). Isibonelo, uma ibhande elibomvu lingu-20cm, 1/2 ngu-10cm, kodwa uma ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lingu-80cm, 1/4 ngu-20cm, ede, futhi uma ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lingu-8cm, 1/4 ngu-2cm, emfushane. Udinga ukwazi ubude bamabhande amabili ukunquma.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke izingcezu zolwazi lapho ukwazi lokho okukodwa kuphela kukuvumela ukuthi unqume ukuthi ngubani osebenzise okuningi. (Cabanga ngokukhetha ngakunye ngokwehlukana.)
y-m-07-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ulwazi luyiqiniso, setha ibhande elibomvu ku-20cm, yenza izibonelo zobude bebhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngalunye, bese uthola ubude abantu ababili abasebenzise ngabo.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kucezu ngalunye lolwazi, yenza izibonelo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezihlukile zobude bebhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka bese uhlola ukuthi isiphetho sihlala sifana yini.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.a: Ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lide kunebhande elibomvu.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.a: "Ide" yodwa ayikutsheli ukuthi ide kangakanani. Hlola icala lapho ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka licishe libe izikhathi ezi-2 zebhande elibomvu.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.b: Uyazi ukuthi uma okuphelele kufana, ungaqhathanisa osayizi bezingxenyana ngokushesha.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.c: Bobabili abantu basebenzise ingxenye noma ngaphansi kwamabhande abo.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.c: 1/2 no-1/4 sesivele singuhhafu noma ngaphansi. Awufundanga lutho olusha.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.d: Ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lifushane kunebhande elibomvu.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.d: Uma ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lifushane, u-1/4 walo ufushane nakakhulu, futhi ungaliqhathanisa no-1/2 webhande elibomvu. Lokhu kusebenzise ubudlelwano phakathi kosayizi bokuphelele.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.e: Ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka liyizikhathi ezi-4 zobude bebhande elibomvu.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.e: Lolu ulwazi olunika ubudlelwano phakathi kosayizi bokuphelele njengesiphindaphindo esinembile. Ungashintsha u-1/4 ukuze ube ngokwebhande elibomvu.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.explain: Biza ibhande elibomvu ngo-R nebhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngo-B. Khona-ke uJian usebenzise ingxenye ka-R futhi uDoyun usebenzise u-1/4 ka-B. Uma amabhande amabili afana, uJian usebenzisa okuningi. Uma ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lifushane, uJian usasebenzisa okuningi. Uma ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lide izikhathi ezi-4, uDoyun usebenzisa okungako ngangoR, ngakho uDoyun usebenzisa okuningi. Uma wazi kuphela ukuthi ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lide, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi lide ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezi-2 yini, ngakho awukwazi ukunquma.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.acc.0: Ukhethe ucezu lolwazi olulungile. Hlola ukuthi ulwazi lokuthi lide izikhathi ezi-4 nalo lungakuvumela ukuthi unqume yini.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.acc.1: Ukhethe ucezu lolwazi olulungile. Hlola ukuthi ulwazi olusho "lifushane" nalo lungakuvumela ukuthi unqume yini.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.acc.2: Ukhethe ucezu lolwazi olulungile. Hlola ukuthi ulwazi olusho "ubude bokuqala bufana" nalo lungakuvumela ukuthi unqume yini.
y-m-07-05.s.s3.prompt: Sho ukuthi ibhande elibomvu lingu-20cm. Ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kufanele libe ngama-cm amangaki ukuze abantu ababili basebenzise ubude obufanayo? Bhala nokuthi ngubani osebenzisa okuningi uma ibhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lide kunalokho. (Amabhande angahlukaniswa abe izingxenye ezilinganayo.)
y-m-07-05.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuthi uhhafu webhande elibomvu ungama-cm amangaki.

y-m-07-05.s.s3.model.1: Ngu-40cm. Uhhafu webhande elibomvu ungu-10cm, futhi ingxenye eyodwa yebhande eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka elihlukaniswe izingxenye ezi-4 ezilinganayo kufanele ibe ngu-10cm. y-m-07-02.title: Izikhwama ezi-6 ezinezimbumbulu ezingu-47 ngasinye, izindlela ezintathu zokubala
y-m-07-02.topic: Izindlela eziningana zokubala (inombolo enamadijithi amabili)×(inombolo enedijithi eyodwa) ngokuhlukanisa inombolo
y-m-07-02.goal: Thola futhi ulungise umugqa ongalungile ezindleleni zokubala ngokuhlukanisa inombolo, bese uhlola ngesibonelo sakho ukuthi ukwenza ukuhlukanisa ngezindlela ezahlukene kunika isamba esifanayo, bese usho ukuthi kungani.
y-m-07-02.material: Kunezimbumbulu ezingu-47 esikhwameni ngasinye, futhi kunezikhwama ezi-6 sebezonke. Abangani abathathu bathole inani eliphelele lezimbumbulu ngokushintsha u-47 waba yinombolo elula ukubala ngayo. Indlela yokufunda: 47×6 ifundwa ngokuthi '47 izikhathi ezi-6'.
y-m-07-02.thinking.1: Ukwenza izindlela eziningana zokuhlukanisa phakathi kwezimo
y-m-07-02.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi kungani iziphumo zifana ngisho noma izindlela zihlukile
y-m-07-02.prereq.2: Ukwenza (inombolo enamadijithi amabili)×(inombolo enedijithi eyodwa) ngendlela eqondile
y-m-07-02.s.s1.prompt: Lezi yizibalo zabangani abathathu. Khetha umugqa owodwa lapho isibalo singalungile.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokuqhathanisa umugqa nomugqa ukuthi abangani abathathu bawubhale kabusha kanjani u-47.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa izinombolo abangani abathathu abazisebenzisile no-47, bese uhlola umugqa nomugqa ukuthi bengeze noma basuse yini.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.line.0: UJian: Hlukanisa u-47 ube ngu-40 no-7. 40×6=240, 7×6=42.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.line.2: UDoha: Bona u-47 njengo-3 ngaphansi kuka-50. 50×6=300, 3×6=18.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.line.4: USeoa: Hlukanisa u-47 ube ngu-45 no-2. 45×6=270, 2×6=12.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 4 awulungile. UDoha ubone u-47 njengo-"3 ngaphansi kuka-50," ngakho ku-50×6=300 kumele asuse u-3×6=18, okunika u-300−18=282. Ukwengeza kwenza kube sengathi ubale ngo-53 esikhundleni sika-47. Izibalo zikaJian nezikaSeoa zombili zinika u-282 ofanayo.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukubala u-47×6 ngokuhlukanisa u-47 abe izinombolo ezimbili a no-b. Yenza ukuhlukanisa okungu-3 okuhlukile okulula ukukubala. Imibandela: a no-b kuyizinombolo zemvelo futhi a+b=47. Futhi eyodwa yazo zombili kumele ibe yinombolo evela ethebuleni lokuphindaphinda lika-5 (okuphindwe ngo-5). Ukuhlukanisa ube ngu-40 no-7 nokuhlukanisa ube ngu-7 no-40 kubalwa njengokuhlukanisa okufanayo.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokuhlola ukuthi a no-b buyakhuphuka buze bube ngu-47.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha inombolo evela ethebuleni lokuphindaphinda lika-5, uyisuse ku-47, bese uthola enye inombolo.

y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Uma ubale ukuhlukanisa ngakunye owakwenzile, uthole izimbumbulu ezingakanani? Emshweni owodwa noma emibili, bhala ukuthi kungani isiphumo sifana ngisho noma indlela yokuhlukanisa ihlukile.

y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ingabe inani eliphelele lezimbumbulu lingashintsha kuye ngokulandelana kokubala izikhwama ezi-6 ezingu-47.

y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lokhu kuthole ukuthi 518 mkhulu ngo-18 kuno-500 futhi 487 mncane ngo-13 kuno-500, futhi kwaqhathanisa inani eliweqile nenani elishodayo. Iyindlela enhle yokubheka amanani alinganiselwe futhi ngezinombolo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 487 mncane kuno-500, ngakho isamba naso sincane kuno-1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Lokhu kushiye ukuthi 518 mkhulu kuno-500. Kumele ubheke ukuthi intengo ngayinye ihluke kangakanani ku-500 ndawonye.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zombili zicishe zibe ngu-500, ngakho isamba singu-1000 won ncamashi njengoba sinjalo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: "Cishe" akusho okufanayo. Thola umehluko phakathi kwenombolo yethegi lentengo ngayinye no-500.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ukulinganisela kuphela akusitsheli, ngakho ngizongeza 487+518 ncamashi ukuze nginqume.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Lesi sinqumo sicabanga ukuthi ukulinganisela akwanele futhi sizama ukuhlola ngokubala ncamashi. Ukuthambekela okuhle ukusebenzisa ukulinganisela nokubala ndawonye.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.info: UHajun uthole izinhlamvu zemali ezingu-2 ezingu-10 won ngaphakathi kwesikhwama sakhe. Manje imali anayo ingu-1020 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Angasho ini uma enza isahlulelo kufakwe neqiniso elisha?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 1005 won mncane kuno-1020 won, ngakho angakwazi ukuzithenga futhi kusala u-15 won. Ngisho noma amanani efana, uma imali onayo ishintsha, isiphetho siyashintsha. Ukunquma ngesilinganiso esingu-1000 kuphela kwakulungile kulokhu, kodwa isizathu sakho sasibuthaka.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Isamba singu-1005 won, okungaphezulu kuno-1000 won, ngakho usengakwazi ukuzithenga.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lokhu akubekanga izinhlamvu zemali esanda kutholakala emalini anayo. Qala ngokuhlola ukuthi imali anayo ishintshile yini.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Isamba esingu-1005 won sincane kuneminingi anayo engu-1020 won, ngakho angazithenga.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lokhu kuqhathanise ngqo imali anayo eshintshile nesamba sangempela. Kubonise kahle ukuthi ulwazi olusha lushintsha isimo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Isilinganiso esingu-1000 sincane kuno-1020, ngakho angazithenga ngokubuka nje isilinganiso.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Isiphetho siyafana, kodwa buyela ucabange ukuthi isilinganiso nesamba sangempela bahluke kanjani. Ukuqhathanisa izilinganiso komunye nomunye kunzima ukukwethemba uma umehluko mncane.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 1005 no-1020 buyafana, ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 1005 no-1020 kungaqhathaniswa ngokushesha. Qhathanisa osayizi bezinombolo ukuze ubone ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.reflect: Ngesitatimende sokuthi isilinganiso ekuqaleni sasingu-1000, yini obungayisho nokuthi yini obungengakwazi ukuyisho? Ngemva kokubona izinombolo eziyiyo ezitegini zamanani, nangemva kokuthola izinhlamvu zemali ezengeziwe, ukucabanga kwakho noma ukuqiniseka kwakho kushintshe kanjani? Uma ugcine ukucabanga kwakho kokuqala njengoba kwakunjalo, sho nokuthi kungani.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amapheya amabili amanani lapho isamba sezilinganiso singu-1000 won kodwa isamba sangempela asiyona u-1000 won. Elilodwa pheya kumele libe nesamba esikhulu kuno-1000 won, futhi elinye pheya kumele libe nesamba esincane kuno-1000 won. Okokudla okulula a won nesiphuzo b won ngasinye siyinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-100 won kuya ku-999 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokwenza ipheya elinesamba esikhulu kuno-1000. Yenza elinye inani libe ngaphezulu kancane kuno-500 bese elinye libe ngaphansi kancane kuno-500.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.1: Uma usuyenzile ipheya elilodwa, shintshanisa inani elingaphezulu nelingaphansi ukuze wenze ipheya elinesamba esincane kuno-1000.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Wonke amanani womabili ayizinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-100 won kuya ku-999 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Wonke amanani kumele abe yizinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-100 kuya ku-999.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Ukulinganisela ngayinye kuze kufike emakhulwini eliseduze bese wengeza kunika u-1000.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukulinganisela intengo ngayinye kuze kufike emakhulwini eliseduze bese wengeza akunikeli u-1000. Hlola umthetho wokuthi uyakhuphukela uma ikhoyilo yamashumi ingu-5 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Uma isamba sangempela singu-1000 won ngqo, siyafana nesilinganiso, ngakho akuyona isibonelo.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.explain: 487+518=1005 mkhulu kuno-1000, futhi 480+510=990 mncane kuno-1000. Ngisho noma izilinganiso zifana, 1000, izamba zangempela zingaba ezinhlangothini zombili zomkhawulo wokuqhathanisa. Ngakho uma isilinganiso silingana nomkhawulo wokuqhathanisa, ungazinqumi ngokulinganisela kuphela; bheka ngokucophelela kakhulu.
